before: Type the level from its part of TOOLKIT_ARC-0026.md (one file, a part per level), compile the Story (log.txt: 0 error(s), 0 warning(s)) and tell Claude; then play that level's session here.
Console edition (Script Extender off) unless a test says PC edition.
A Windborn (Unbound subclass) character with no armour and no shield, unless a test says otherwise.
The stage 1 probes (P1–P9) all passed on 2026-10-17; they are recorded in QA-0004.
2026-10-23: the Owner changed the build in the Toolkit while playing levels 1–8 (WB52–WB61). Tests already played keep

sessions.name: Level 1 — The Open Road
sessions.setup: A level-1 Windborn, no armour and no shield, in a fight with at least three enemies spread out and one ally in melee with an enemy.

tests.expected: The subclass is The Windborn. The preset is STR 8, DEX 15, CON 13, INT 15, WIS 10, CHA 10. Armour Class = 10 + DEX + INT (Be the Leaf). Level-1 spells: Gale Burst only (no True Strike)
tests.fails: The old name Unbound anywhere, another preset, Wisdom in the AC, or True Strike in the list
tests.steps: Create a Windborn at level 1 (or respec one). Look at the subclass name, the default abilities and the character sheet
tests.title: The class reads The Windborn; the preset and the AC are right

tests.expected: Zephyr Strike and Zephyr Rush both appear after the attack (and after a card). The Rush runs to the target and strikes it with no opportunity attack on the way. It needs no weapon and has no Short Rest cooldown
tests.fails: No Zephyr after the attack, an opportunity attack on the way, a weapon requirement, or a cooldown
tests.steps: Hit an enemy with an unarmed attack. In the bonus actions, cast Zephyr Rush on an unmarked enemy 6–9 m away, past another enemy
tests.title: After an unarmed attack, Zephyr Rush carries you to an unmarked enemy

tests.expected: The Windswept enemy can't be targeted. At level 1 the 11 m enemy is out of range (9 m); Zephyr Strike still works on the marked one
tests.fails: The Rush can target a Windswept enemy, or reaches beyond 9 m
tests.steps: Hover Zephyr Rush over a Windswept enemy, then over an unmarked one about 11 m away
tests.title: The Rush only reaches an unmarked enemy within 9 m

tests.expected: Both enemies you damaged show Windswept; the missed one doesn't
tests.fails: No mark on damage, or a mark on a miss
tests.steps: Hit one enemy with an unarmed attack, another with a card that deals damage, and miss a third
tests.title: Damage marks Windswept; a miss doesn't

tests.expected: The enemy that fails is pushed, Prone and Windswept; the one that succeeds isn't marked. Gale Burst no longer gives a free unarmed strike, and its tooltip no longer says "Afterwards…"
tests.fails: A success marks, a failure doesn't, or the free strike is still there
tests.steps: Cast Gale Burst on an enemy (try until one fails and one succeeds)
tests.title: Gale Burst: a failed save marks; no free strike any more

tests.expected: The marked enemy doesn't attack; the unmarked one makes its usual opportunity attack
tests.fails: The marked enemy attacks, or the unmarked one doesn't
tests.steps: Mark the enemy next to your melee ally. On the ally's turn, walk away from it. Do the same next to an unmarked enemy
tests.title: A Windswept enemy makes no opportunity attack

tests.expected: The mark counts down on your turns only and ends at the end of your next turn
tests.fails: It ends on the enemy's turn, after only one of your turns, or lasts longer
tests.steps: Mark an enemy on your turn. End the turn; play your next turn and end it
tests.title: Windswept lasts until the end of your next turn

tests.expected: Weightless shows in the passives; movement +3 m without armour; no Twinkle Toes
tests.fails: No bonus, the wrong bonus, or Twinkle Toes still there
tests.rule: WB39, WB47 — superseded by WB59 (+4 m); see L1.13
tests.steps: Compare your movement with and without armour
tests.title: Weightless: +3 m

tests.expected: No mark, no Zephyr Strike or Rush, no Weightless bonus, no Be the Leaf. Take it off and they come back
tests.fails: Any of them works in armour or with a shield
tests.steps: Put on armour (then a shield instead). Hit an enemy with an unarmed attack; look at AC and movement
tests.title: Armour or a shield turns everything off

tests.expected: The Open Road explains Windswept, the Open Path and Zephyr; no card says "Afterwards"; no id or raw handle shows
tests.fails: An old text, a raw handle or an id
tests.steps: Read the tooltips of The Open Road, Windswept, Zephyr Strike, Zephyr Rush and Gale Burst
tests.title: The Open Road and the cards read right

tests.expected: Zephyr Strike and Zephyr Rush are conjured to the hand for the turn
tests.fails: Only Zephyr Strike, or neither
tests.steps: On the PC edition (Script Extender on), make an unarmed attack in combat
tests.title: PC edition: the deck conjures Zephyr Rush

tests.expected: The Rush spends the bonus action and the metres it covers; with too little movement left it is refused
tests.fails: It costs no movement, or it is allowed with no movement left
tests.steps: Move part of your speed, then Zephyr Rush an unmarked enemy 8 m away; next turn Rush first with full movement
tests.title: Zephyr Rush costs the movement it covers

tests.expected: +4 m without armour; jump and falling as normal
tests.fails: Another bonus, or a jump or fall change at rank 1
tests.steps: Compare your movement with and without armour
tests.title: Weightless rank 1: +4 m

sessions.name: Level 2 — Aeolus' Bag
sessions.setup: Level 2, a fight with at least four enemies; mark several before opening the bag.

tests.expected: Greyed out with no Windswept enemy; usable (bonus action) once one is marked. It offers Boreas and Notus
tests.fails: Usable with no mark, or still greyed with a mark
tests.steps: Look at Aeolus' Bag before marking anyone, then after marking one enemy
tests.title: The bag needs a Windswept enemy

tests.expected: Every mark is cleared. "The bag is open" shows 2 turns (3 marks, capped at 2 at Breeze). The bag stays shut while the wind blows
tests.fails: The marks stay, the number isn't the capped count, or the bag can open again
tests.steps: Mark 3 enemies. Open the bag with Boreas
tests.title: Opening: X = marks, capped at 2; every mark is cleared

tests.expected: Allies get a tailwind (+3 m); Windswept enemies a headwind (−3 m); unmarked enemies nothing
tests.fails: Wrong amounts, or unmarked enemies affected
tests.steps: With Boreas blowing, mark an enemy; compare an ally's and that enemy's movement
tests.title: Boreas: allies +3 m, Windswept enemies −3 m

tests.expected: The ranged attack has Disadvantage; the Windswept enemy's save shows −1
tests.fails: No Disadvantage, or no penalty
tests.steps: Open the bag with Notus; let an enemy shoot an ally; make a Windswept enemy roll a save
tests.title: Notus: ranged attacks against allies at Disadvantage; Windswept enemies −1 to saves

tests.expected: At your turn start every mark is cleared; the turns of "the bag is open" go down by one at each of your turn ends; at 0 the wind stops and the bag can open again
tests.fails: The marks stay, the count is wrong, or the wind never stops
tests.steps: With a wind blowing, mark two enemies; end your turn; start the next one
tests.title: While the wind blows, your turn starts with a sweep

tests.expected: Aeolus' Bag appears in the hand (0 Threads) with its winds
tests.fails: No bag in the hand
tests.steps: On the PC edition, mark an enemy in combat
tests.title: PC edition: the bag is conjured once you have a mark

sessions.name: Level 3 — The First Step, The Calm, Wind Blast
sessions.setup: Level 3, a fight with at least four enemies.

tests.expected: The Awakening status counts "Windswept marks left to release to awaken The First Step" down from 3; at 0 The First Step wakes
tests.fails: Another count, the old Wanderlust text, or no tier
tests.steps: Mark 3 enemies and release them (open the bag, or let a sweep take them). Watch the Awakening status
tests.title: Tier I wakes after 3 marks are released

tests.expected: The first Rush each turn costs no bonus action; a second Zephyr that turn costs it
tests.fails: Every Rush is free, or none
tests.steps: With The First Step awake, use Zephyr Rush twice on two turns (after an unarmed attack each time)
tests.title: The First Step: the first Rush each turn is free

tests.expected: Greyed with no wind. Cast: the wind stops at once, each Windswept enemy takes 1d8 Thunder per turn left, every mark is swept, and the bag can open again the same turn
tests.fails: Usable without wind, wrong damage, or the bag stays shut
tests.steps: Look at The Calm with no wind; open the bag (2+ turns), mark enemies, cast The Calm
tests.title: The Calm: only while a wind blows; the turns left become gusts

tests.expected: Each creature that fails is pushed, Off Balance and Windswept; one that succeeds isn't marked; no "Afterwards…" in the text
tests.fails: A success marks, a failure doesn't
tests.steps: Cast Wind Blast on a group
tests.title: Wind Blast marks those who fail

tests.expected: Level 3 adds Wind Blast and The Calm (Aspect card); Flow State, Gale Deflection and its resources come at level 6; no Twinkle Toes
tests.fails: Flow State or Gale Deflection still at 3
tests.steps: Look at the level-3 spells and resources
tests.title: Flow State and Gale Deflection are no longer at level 3

sessions.name: Level 4 — Gale
sessions.setup: Level 4, a fight with at least four enemies.

tests.expected: Both push the target 3 m. The Rush now reaches 12 m. The Gale passive shows
tests.fails: No push, the wrong distance, or still 9 m
tests.rule: WB16, WB17 (Gale) — the 12 m Rush superseded by WB52 (9 m at every rank); see L4.4
tests.steps: Zephyr Strike a Windswept enemy; Zephyr Rush an unmarked one about 11 m away
tests.title: Zephyr pushes 3 m; the Rush reaches 12 m

tests.expected: The bag offers Eurus. "The bag is open" shows 3 turns. Allies +1 to attack rolls; Windswept enemies −1
tests.fails: No Eurus, the wrong cap, or wrong bonuses
tests.steps: Mark 4 enemies; open the bag with Eurus; an ally attacks; a Windswept enemy attacks
tests.title: Eurus joins the bag; the cap is 3

tests.expected: +4.5 m movement, jump ×2, half falling damage (rank 1 gone)
tests.fails: Rank 1 still there, or wrong values
tests.rule: WB47 (Weightless 2) — superseded by WB59 (+7 m); see L4.4
tests.steps: Check movement, jump distance and falling damage
tests.title: Weightless rank 2

tests.expected: The 11 m enemy is out of reach, the 8 m one is reached; +7 m movement, jump ×2, half falling damage
tests.fails: The Rush reaches 12 m, or other Weightless values
tests.steps: Zephyr Rush an unmarked enemy about 11 m away, then one about 8 m away; check movement, jump and a fall
tests.title: Gale: the Rush stays 9 m; Weightless rank 2 is +7 m

tests.expected: Wind Whispers' own effect plus the opening Advantage (the status Evasive Flow used to give)
tests.fails: No Advantage
tests.rule: WB33 (Wind Whispers) — changed by WB57, WB58; see L5.3
tests.steps: Cast Wind Whispers, then attack
tests.title: Wind Whispers also gives the Advantage Evasive Flow gave

tests.expected: Flowing Assault works as before; no Twinkle Toes or Feather Fall at level 5 (Weightless rank 2 stays)
tests.fails: Twinkle Toes or the old Weightless 5 present
tests.steps: Read Flowing Assault and Wind Whispers; check the passives
tests.title: Flowing Assault and the level-5 texts

tests.expected: Usable out of combat; lasts 2 turns; Disadvantage only on the unmarked enemy's attack; the Riposte asks before striking, and only against the unmarked one
tests.fails: Refused out of combat, Disadvantage or Riposte against the Windswept enemy, or the Riposte fires without asking
tests.steps: Out of combat, cast Wind Whispers (it should work). In a fight, cast it; let an unmarked enemy and a Windswept one attack you in melee and miss
tests.title: Wind Whispers: 2 turns, only against unmarked melee; the Riposte asks

sessions.name: Level 6 — Flow State, Ready: Gale Deflection
sessions.setup: Level 6, a fight with a ranged enemy and an ally within 3 m of you.

tests.expected: 3 turns at every slot, one extra bonus action each turn
tests.fails: Duration grows with the slot, or no extra bonus action
tests.steps: Cast Flow State at its base slot, then at a higher slot (another fight)
tests.title: Flow State: 3 turns and one extra bonus action, at every slot

tests.expected: You can react for yourself and for the ally within 3 m; not for the one 5 m away. Its id doesn't show in the combat log
tests.fails: No reaction for the near ally, a reaction for the far one, or an id in the log
tests.rule: WB32 (Gale Deflection) — changed by WB57 (one use per turn, unmarked shooters only); see L6.3
tests.steps: Let a ranged enemy shoot you, then an ally 2 m from you, then one 5 m away
tests.title: Gale Deflection also protects an ally within 3 m

tests.expected: Costs a level-3 slot (4–6 as upcasts); one reaction per turn; none against the Windswept archer; the ally nearby is covered. Flow State works out of combat and stays when equipment changes
tests.fails: A level-2 slot, two uses in one turn, a reaction against a Windswept archer, or Flow State refused out of combat or lost on the glove change
tests.steps: Cast Ready: Gale Deflection (check the slot). Let an unmarked archer shoot you twice in one round, then a Windswept one; let one shoot an ally next to you. Out of combat, cast Flow State and change your gloves
tests.title: Gale Deflection: a level-3 slot, once per turn, unmarked shooters only; Flow State out of combat

sessions.name: Level 7 — Fellow Travellers, Zephyr: Tempest
sessions.setup: Level 7, a fight with allies attacking enemies.

tests.expected: The enemy becomes Windswept (your mark: it counts for your bag and Awakening and lasts 2 of your turns)
tests.fails: No mark, or the mark doesn't count for you
tests.steps: With Tier II awake (goal 5), let an ally hit an unmarked enemy
tests.title: Fellow Travellers: an ally's hit marks the enemy in your name

tests.expected: It counts down to Fellow Travellers from 5
tests.fails: Another number
tests.steps: Release marks after Tier I and watch the Awakening status
tests.title: Tier II needs 5 released marks

tests.expected: Extra Thunder damage on the unmarked enemy only; 3 turns at every slot
tests.fails: Extra damage on the Windswept enemy, or a different duration
tests.rule: WB34 (Storm Fists) — superseded by WB54 (Zephyr: Tempest, Windswept targets only); see L7.4
tests.steps: Cast Storm Fists; punch an unmarked enemy, then a Windswept one
tests.title: Storm Fists: extra damage only against enemies that aren't Windswept; 3 turns

tests.expected: On yourself for 3 turns; the Windswept enemy takes +1d6 + DEX Thunder and 2 turns of Reverberation, once per attack; nothing on the unmarked one; at level 5 +2d6 + DEX. No Storm Fists in the spells
tests.fails: Extra damage on the unmarked enemy, Reverberation twice per attack, the wrong dice, or Storm Fists still there
tests.steps: Cast Zephyr: Tempest at level 4 (bonus action); punch a Windswept enemy, then an unmarked one; next fight cast it at level 5
tests.title: Zephyr: Tempest: extra Thunder and Reverberation on Windswept targets, 3 turns

sessions.name: Level 8 — Storm
sessions.setup: Level 8, a fight with at least five enemies.

tests.expected: A second Rush appears for this turn (free, 9 m, only an unmarked enemy) and goes once used; a missed Rush gives none
tests.fails: No second Rush, it costs an action, it stays, or a miss grants it
tests.rule: WB16 (Storm) · TC C3 — superseded by WB53; see L8.3
tests.steps: Zephyr Rush an unmarked enemy and hit it; look at the bonus actions; Rush again to another unmarked enemy within 9 m
tests.title: Storm: after a Rush that deals damage, one more free Rush

tests.expected: "The bag is open" shows 4 turns; +6 m movement, jump ×3, half falling damage
tests.fails: Another cap or wrong values
tests.rule: WB13 (cap 4), WB47 — Weightless superseded by WB59 (+10 m); see L8.4
tests.steps: Mark 5 enemies and open the bag; check movement and jump
tests.title: The cap is 4; Weightless rank 3

tests.expected: The second Rush (Zephyr Rush: Storm) appears as soon as the first is cast, reaches 12 m, may land on a Windswept enemy, costs half the movement it covers and deals unarmed damage + DEX as Thunder; it goes once used
tests.fails: No second Rush, it needs a hit first, it refuses a Windswept enemy, the wrong range or cost, or it stays
tests.steps: Zephyr Rush an unmarked enemy; look at the bonus actions; use the second Rush on a Windswept enemy about 11 m away
tests.title: Storm: casting the Rush grants a second Rush — 12 m, any enemy, half the movement

tests.expected: +10 m movement, jump ×3, half falling damage
tests.fails: Other values
tests.steps: Check movement, jump and a fall
tests.title: Weightless rank 3: +10 m

tests.expected: +2 AC while flying; Eye of the Storm no longer shows anywhere
tests.fails: No AC, or Eye of the Storm still there
tests.steps: Cast Untethered; compare AC before and after
tests.title: Untethered: flying gives +2 AC

tests.expected: Empty State at level 9 (not 12); Untethered in the spells; no Evasive Flow
tests.fails: Empty State missing or Evasive Flow still in the list
tests.steps: Look at the level-9 passives and spells
tests.title: Empty State arrives at 9; Evasive Flow is gone

tests.expected: Half damage from the Windswept enemy's hit only; Evasion on the Windswept caster's DEX save; full damage from the unmarked one
tests.fails: Half damage from the unmarked enemy, or no reduction from the Windswept one
tests.steps: Let a Windswept enemy and an unmarked one hit you; let a Windswept caster force a DEX save
tests.title: Empty State: half damage only from Windswept attackers

sessions.name: Level 10 — Zephyr: Ally Tempest
sessions.setup: Level 10, a fight with an armed ally and several enemies, some Windswept.

tests.expected: On the ally for 5 turns; +1d4 Thunder and 1 turn of Reverberation on the Windswept enemy only; no Leap of Faith anywhere in the spells
tests.fails: Extra damage on the unmarked enemy, the wrong duration, castable on yourself or an enemy, or Leap of Faith still there
tests.steps: Cast Zephyr: Ally Tempest on an ally (bonus action, level-5 slot); let the ally hit a Windswept enemy, then an unmarked one; count the turns
tests.title: Zephyr: Ally Tempest: an ally's weapon hits on Windswept enemies add Thunder and Reverberation

sessions.name: Level 11 — Unleashed Winds
sessions.setup: Level 11, a fight with several enemies, some Windswept.

tests.expected: Greyed while the bag is open. Without it, it targets a point on the ground (no enemy under the cursor) and spends an action and a level-6 slot
tests.fails: Usable with the bag open, it needs a creature as the target, or another cost
tests.steps: Open the bag and try Unleashed Winds; when the wind ends, aim it at an empty spot of ground within 18 m
tests.title: Aimed at the ground; refused while the bag is open; a level-6 slot

tests.expected: Each makes a Strength save. On a failure: 4d8 Thunder, the Windswept enemy pulled 6 m toward the point, the unmarked one pushed 6 m away, both Off Balance for 1 turn. On a success: half damage, no move
tests.fails: Both move the same way, a DEX save, wrong distances, or Off Balance on a success
tests.steps: With a Windswept enemy and an unmarked one each about 5 m from the point, cast it
tests.title: Windswept enemies pulled 6 m in, the others pushed 6 m out; STR save

tests.expected: Unleashed Winds in the spells; none of the retired pieces
tests.fails: Any retired piece still there
tests.steps: Look at the level-11 spells and passives
tests.title: Thunderclap, Momentum, Storm Fists, Leap of Faith and Where the Winds Meet are gone

sessions.name: Level 12 — Into the Storm, Hurricane
sessions.setup: Level 12, a fight with at least five enemies.

tests.expected: Every swept enemy is pushed 3 m away from you and is Off Balance — the sweep that wakes the tier included
tests.fails: No push, the wrong direction, or the waking sweep doesn't push
tests.steps: Wake Tier III (goal 8); let a sweep release marks
tests.title: Into the Storm: each sweep pushes the swept enemies 3 m

tests.expected: The bag offers the pairs (Boreas + Notus, Boreas + Eurus, Notus + Eurus) instead of single winds; both winds blow; "the bag is open" shows 5 turns
tests.fails: Single winds still offered, only one wind blows, or another cap
tests.steps: Mark 6 enemies and open the bag
tests.title: Hurricane: the bag offers two winds at once; the cap is 5

tests.expected: +13 m movement, jump ×4, no falling damage
tests.fails: Wrong values
tests.steps: Check movement, jump and a long fall
tests.title: Weightless rank 4

tests.expected: No ability bonus from the tiers, no Fool's Luck reaction or resource; levels 13–20 add no Twinkle Toes
tests.fails: An old tier bonus or Fool's Luck still there
tests.steps: Look at the tier passives and resources; level to 13 if you can
tests.title: No old tier bonuses; no Fool's Luck; nothing after 12

sessions.name: Any level — full run
sessions.setup: A full fight at levels 3, 8 and 12 (TC part C), after all levels are typed.

tests.expected: A Rush most turns; the bag by turn 2–3; every wind chosen in some fights (none above about 60%)
tests.fails: A turn every time without a choice, no bag, or one wind always
tests.steps: Play a few fights at levels 3, 5–8 and 12 and note the turns
tests.title: How the fights play

tests.expected: Damage within about ±15% of the Monk; each tier wakes on turn 2–3
tests.fails: More than 15% over, or a tier after turn 4
tests.steps: At level 12 compare your damage per turn with a Monk's; note the turn each tier wakes at 3, 7 and 12
tests.title: Power and tiers against the Monk

tests.expected: Zephyr Strike is called Zephyr Strike; "West Wind" everywhere, no "Weast"; "Windswept", "Wind Whispers", "Unleashed Winds"; Eurus and Boreas named the East and North Winds; no "### EMPTY"; the Zephyr: Ally Tempest status has an icon
tests.fails: Any of the listed slips still shows
tests.steps: Read Zephyr Strike, Zephyr Rush, Windswept, Aeolus' Bag and its pairs, Wind Whispers (passive), Unleashed Winds, Ready: Gale Deflection and its reaction; hover the hidden statuses
tests.title: Names and texts read right

title: The Windborn — rework WB0–WB61 (levels 1–12)
